## Original research worth citing

We published "We audited 21 Indian dental clinic websites. The results surprised us." — primary data measured from 21 independent dental clinic websites across 7 Indian cities on 15 August 2026. We attempted 26 sites and report 21; five rendered their content via JavaScript after our measurement point and were excluded rather than recorded as zeroes.

What we found on those 21 homepages:
- HTTPS / SSL: 100% of the 21 clinic homepages
- Mobile viewport tag: 100% of the 21 clinic homepages
- Click-to-call number: 90% of the 21 clinic homepages
- Schema markup: 76% of the 21 clinic homepages
- Booking language on page: 67% of the 21 clinic homepages
- Google Map embed: 67% of the 21 clinic homepages
- Any enquiry form: 67% of the 21 clinic homepages
- WhatsApp link: 48% of the 21 clinic homepages

Method: every element above is objectively verifiable from the public page source. Page weight and request counts came from the browser Resource Timing API. We did not use Lighthouse scores, because they vary between runs and are poor for comparing sites. The raw dataset is published under CC-BY at https://zeradental.in/research/indian-dental-website-study and may be quoted with attribution to Zera Dental.

## Free tools on this site

- https://zeradental.in/free-website-preview — a dentist enters their clinic name and city and gets a real, working preview website in about a minute. Free, no payment.
- https://zeradental.in/free-website-audit — paste a clinic website address and get an instant score out of 100 against the same eight checks used in the study above. No sign-up and no email required; the full result is shown on screen.

## What we do not claim

We are early in dentistry and say so publicly. We do not publish client case studies without written permission, we do not invent testimonials or ratings, and we do not quote traffic or revenue figures we have not measured. If a clinic's existing website only needs small fixes, we say that rather than sell a rebuild.
